visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Strategy Objects Instead of a Mode String
visualizerParams.problemDescription: checkout decides what to do by comparing a mode string with an if / else-if chain. Create a Discount interface with one class per mode and pass the object instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A misspelt mode string compiles and silently returns the full price, while a missing class is a compile error. A new discount is a new class, and checkout never changes.
